access_condition: adaptive white-box-aware (true encoder granted, differentiated through end-to-end) — strictly stronger than the base matrix's matched access; NOT comparable as a matched-access row
utility_source: carried verbatim from the base cell; the attack cannot change training-time utility

calibration.source: public calibration partition of the 96-article development corpus

access.public_head: pretrained public head exported before victim training (split{N}/public-head-{seed}.pt)
access.public_defense_decoder: granted when the defense exposes a cloud decoder (bottleneck v2 geometry, pca-compress basis)

defense_aware_arm.knowledge: defense CLASS and released width k only (no defense weights or randomness)
defense_aware_arm.surrogate: PCA encoder+inverse fit on the public calibration partition at the same k
defense_aware_arm.use: learned prior over the observed wire for the forward/beam/SIPIT kernels (BPDA-style straight-through approximation)

access.observations: post-defense training-phase fwd wire captures plus canonical scoring truth (scoring only)

query_budgets.ridge_fit: one pass over the public calibration partition

whitebox_extension.granted: the defended cell's ACTUAL trained defense checkpoint and provenance sidecar (encoder weights for tb-*, fitted PCA basis for pca-compress), used as the exact training-phase transform the attack differentiates through, in addition to everything the defense-aware surrogate arm holds
whitebox_extension.strength: strictly stronger than the surrogate arm's defense-class + k + public-calibration knowledge, and adaptive where the whitebox pipeline arms are not: the attack is customized end-to-end against the true transform
whitebox_extension.rationale: mirrors the defense framework's assumption that the current transform is necessarily visible to the executor, and evaluates the adaptive adversary who optimizes straight through it

arms.adaptive_e2e: joint Adam optimization of each wire's full continuous token sequence straight through the TRUE encoder against the released z (minimize ||encoder(x) - z_released||), snapped to the vocabulary by a single Euclidean nearest-embedding readout; no inverter, ridge map, beam or SIPIT stages

whitebox_extension.budget_mapping: steps_per_wire = the sweep's SIPIT step count (128 at the raised budgets): exactly sipit_steps joint full-sequence Adam steps through the true encoder per wire, vs SIPIT's steps-per-TOKEN head-side budget; the single terminal snap costs n_sequences * seq_len * vocab vocabulary dot products and no head forward calls
whitebox_extension.caveat: adaptive white-box recovery is measured under strictly stronger access; it does not constrain black-box recovery of the same wire, nor the surrogate arm or any defense-internals-hidden adversary

adaptive_e2e.objective: minimize ||encoder(x) - z_released|| over the wire's full continuous token sequence, straight through the TRUE defense transform (Adam); no intermediate decode stages
adaptive_e2e.init: uniform random vocabulary embeddings (seeded per-cell stream under fork_rng + manual_seed)
adaptive_e2e.budget_match: one joint full-sequence optimization budget equal to the sweep's SIPIT step count, vs SIPIT's steps-per-token head-side budget
